newsitem.title: GERMANY: GERMAN DATA DUE - Prelim West German CPI due Monday.
newsitem.headline: GERMAN DATA DUE - Prelim West German CPI due Monday.

text.p: The German Federal Statistics Office said on Monday that preliminary west German inflation figures for January would be published on Monday instead of on Thursday or Friday as originally expected.
West German inflation grew 0.3 percent month-on-month and 1.4 percent year-on-year in December.
The Statistics Office did not specify at what time the preliminary consumer price index would be released.
